briefdescription.para: Return the encoded size of the first CBOR data item.

detaileddescription.para:
The item must be well-formed. Bytes after it are ignored. This function does not check nesting depth, UTF-8, tag content, or duplicate map keys.
encoded
Bytes that begin with the item.
The item's size in bytes, or an error if it is incomplete, malformed, indefinite-length, or exceeds an active size limit.
Limits and errors
too_little_data: input ends before the item or its claimed children. syntax_error: an invalid head or reserved simple value. indefinite_length: a head uses indefinite length. string_length_exceeded: a string exceeds an active limit. container_elements_exceeded: a container exceeds an active limit.
Complexity
O(i), where i is the number of item heads examined, bounded by O(n) for n bytes in the item. Uses O(1) auxiliary memory and allocates nothing.
Interactive example
* bytes: 82 01 02 07 * call: cbor::item_size(bytes) * result: 3 * call: cbor::item_size(bytes.substr(3)) * result: 1 *
Interactive example 2
* bytes: 83 01 02 03 * call: cbor::item_size(bytes) * result: 4 *
Example
* // bytes: [1, 2] followed by 7, 4 bytes * cbor::item_size(bytes); // 3 * cbor::item_size(bytes.substr(0, 2)); // too_little_data * // bytes: [_ 1] * cbor::item_size(bytes); // indefinite_length *
